description: Read a UN packaging mark part by part (packaging code, performance level, density or gross mass, test pressure, year, state, maker; IBC, large packaging, salvage and reconditioned marks too). Add a UN number to check whether the container may carry that substance under ADR 2025. Reads a mark with or without the "UN" prefix, and a bare code such as 3H1. If the user has not read the mark off the container, ask them for it rather than passing a description of the container.

un.description: Optional UN number to check the mark against
